more_chat_history.setting.save_history.t: Saves every message the chat shows (private ones too) to chat_history.log in the game folder and shows the newest ones again next session.
more_chat_history.setting.max_file_mib.t: chat_history.log keeps about this much of the newest messages.
more_chat_history.setting.sound.tooltip: A short keyboard click, picked at random from six, when a message from another player arrives.
more_chat_history.setting.sound_system: Sound for server and system messages
more_chat_history.setting.sound_system.t: Joins, deaths, command output and other lines that are not from a player.
